cases.round1_note: The same unit error was already present in round 1: 0.0996 was emitted where approximately 9.96 percentage points were expected.

cases.amendment_regression: Round 1 achieved workflow score 1.0. After the v2 greenshoe update, freshness and handoffs remained correct but new arithmetic errors reduced the score to 0.9325 and caused enterprise failure.

cross_case_observations.freshness: Both runs updated all four artifacts and left no stale v1 artifact.
cross_case_observations.risk_handling: Both runs preserved the complete supported risk set without unsupported additions.
cross_case_observations.dominant_result: Perfect handoff consistency can coexist with enterprise failure when the shared calculation or unit is wrong.
cross_case_observations.stateful_result: Rubrik demonstrates a direct static-to-stateful regression: a perfect round-1 workflow failed after a legitimate amendment despite correct evidence freshness.

claim_boundary: These are natural pilot results for one free model, one multi-agent architecture, two IPO cases, and one repetition per case. They are not a leaderboard or a paper-grade population estimate, but they provide two concrete and auditable compositional failure modes.
